[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained the positive impact of real-time feedback on student learning outcomes, including improved accuracy, increased motivation, enhanced metacognition, reduced anxiety, and personalized learning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided best practices for implementing real-time feedback, such as immediate feedback, specific and actionable feedback, multi-modal feedback, student reflection, and teacher involvement.
